'''Japanese Sealed Deck''' is a Star Wars CCG sealed-deck format played with Japanese-language product. [[Decipher]] ran it as a sanctioned side event at [[DecipherCon 1999]] and [[DecipherCon 2000]].<ref name="dc99-fri">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/fri_events.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Schedule (Friday)], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000708001407/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/fri_events.html Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="dcon-sw-events">[http://www.decipher.com/deciphercon/2000/events/starwarsccg.html Star Wars Customizable Card Game events], DecipherCon 2000, Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010126213800/http://www.decipher.com/deciphercon/2000/events/starwarsccg.html Internet Archive].</ref>

* '''Type:''' sealed deck
* '''Defined by:''' Decipher (1999)
* '''Card pool:''' in 2000, a Japanese Premiere starter deck, 1 Japanese limited Premiere booster and 3 Japanese limited A New Hope boosters per player
* '''In use:''' 1999 – 2000
* '''Also called:''' Japanese Sealed (Decipher's 2000 event page)
* '''GEMP:''' none

== Card pool ==
Decipher's DecipherCon 2000 page: "Fans of the Star Wars CCG Japanese expansions will get a chance to play in their very own sealed-deck events. In this format, the cards you play with could be the best prize of all! Each player will be given a Premiere starter, 1 limited Premiere booster and 3 limited A New Hope boosters, all Japanese!"<ref name="dcon-sw-events" />

The product used at DecipherCon 1999 is not on the preserved schedule pages.<ref name="dc99-fri" /><ref name="dc99-sun">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sun_events.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Schedule (Sunday)], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001026063736/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sun_events.html Internet Archive].</ref>

== History ==
DecipherCon 1999 scheduled Japanese Sealed Deck (event SW.23) on Friday 12 November from 8 p.m. to 2 a.m. and on Sunday 14 November from 11 a.m. to 5 p.m.<ref name="dc99-fri" /><ref name="dc99-sun" /> The results are on [[DecipherCon 1999 Japanese Sealed Deck]].

DecipherCon 2000 scheduled it on Friday 6 October at 9 p.m. (event #SW224) and Saturday 7 October at 8 p.m. (event #SW235), four games each, entry $25, sanctioned.<ref name="dcon-sw-events" /><ref name="dcon00-sched">[http://www2.decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swccgevents.pdf DecipherCon Master Tournament Schedule for Decipher Games], DecipherCon 2000, Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20030413152501/http://www2.decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swccgevents.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
